metadata.case_name: WO WANG FU v. WONG KWOK HUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: container truck driver (internal and external delivery worker) for the 2nd Defendant
plaintiff.occupation_after: heavy vehicle dump truck driver for Hin Sum (from 13 February 2017)

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his neck
source: the Plaintiff only sustained soft tissue injury to his neck.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: hearing impairment with right tinnitus; pure tone audiogram shown right hearing loss from 30 dB to 80 dB and left hearing loss from 20 dB to 55 dB
source: The Plaintiff complained of hearing impairment with right tinnitus since February 2012.
Pure tone audiogram shown right hearing loss from 30 dB to 80 dB and left hearing loss from 20 dB to 55 dB.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

source: There is no dispute that the Plaintiff suffered from adjustment disorder after the Accident.
he has fully recovered at the latest by end of November 2012.

injuries.description: Delusional Disorder (Jealous Type) (psychiatric) - diagnosis noted in records (court found it was not caused by the Accident)
source: His diagnosis was revised to Delusional Disorder.
When he was seen on 29 November 2013 with his wife, he was mentally stable with no active psychotic or mood symptoms elicited.

manifestations.description: reduced neck range of movement (neck flexion, extension, side flexion and rotation limited)
pin-prick sensation over the finger tips
decreased power of both arms to Grade 4
hearing 'wee wee' noise and male voices (auditory phenomena reported)
morbid jealousy / delusional symptoms (change of relationship with wife, hitting his wife noted)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital
Accident & Emergency treatment at Yan Chai Hospital
occupational therapy including work capacity evaluation and vocational counselling
neurosurgical admission at PMH (13 October 2011 to 14 October 2011)
psychiatric inpatient treatment at Kwai Chung Hospital (8 September 2012 to 5 October 2012)
clinical psychology outpatient treatment (10 sessions from 23 April 2012 to 26 June 2013) including cognitive-behavioural therapy and stress/anger management training
ENT assessment and pure tone audiogram
treatment by private medical practitioners including bonesetters and Chinese herbalist
treatments_future: treatment for residual pain (award assessed at $3,000)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: After the Accident, he stopped swimming and seldom went out for outdoor activities.
Seldom went out for outdoor activities and reduced participation in leisure outings.
